summary:
Join us in the Exclusive Member Lounge where you can enjoy barista coffee and snacks each day! Rest your feet, charge your devices, network among peers, meet with a Gartner Executive Partners, or find a quiet space to get some work done. If you’d like to book a private meeting room, just ask us for more information at the welcome desk! Rooms are available for you on a first come first served basis. We look forward to hosting you!

For more information regarding your conference benefits, please visit your Exclusive Member Experience page.
